verdict.rationale: MCP-client support is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, since AI-enabled terminals can consume MCP tools, so the story applies. Nothing in Ghostty's docs, GitHub material or runtime probes mentions MCP, connecting to tool servers, or any built-in AI or agent that could use such tools. AppleScript, keybind actions and libghostty are adjacent automation and embedding features, not MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
